name: IBM ContextForge Enterprise

name: Backslash Security
description: MCP scanning, hardening, real-time MCP proxy for IDE / 'vibe coding' workflows.

name: GuardionAI
description: Runtime guardrail + security gateway enforcing policy on MCP tool calls; app-layer (no network controls).

name: Semgrep

name: Snyk

name: Checkmarx
description: Checkmarx One and Developer Assist connect enterprise AppSec with IDE scanning and MCP-based remediation. Lightweight IDE analysis and full project scans have different scopes.

name: Veracode
description: Veracode Fix provides AI-assisted remediation for SAST and SCA findings. Fix for SAST uses Pipeline Scan results and source code, with patches reviewed by developers.

name: GitGuardian
description: Credential exposure and incident workflows, with MCP tools for secret scanning, incident management and remediation PRs. Token scopes control available actions; distinct from application vulnerability analysis.
